notes.title: "Car Empire" October 29, 2021 update content:
notes.content: 1. Fixed the bug that occasionally caused the progress bar to freeze when building 4S.

notes.title: "Car Empire" September 30, 2021 update instructions:
notes.content:
1. Added 4S shop function, now it is possible to build 4S shops in major cities around the world. In addition to increasing car sales, 4S stores can also set 9 different business goals such as research and development technology points.
2. Improved the experience acquisition speed of employees in the process of automobile research and development.

notes.title: "Car Empire" September 9, 2021 update content:
notes.content:
1. With the addition of car iteration functions, iterative upgrades of the cars being sold can now be carried out. According to the iterative effect, additional sales will be increased and the sales time will be extended.
2. Adding the "Entrusted Testing" function, you can entrust a third party to conduct quality testing, and get random results.
3. A shortcut key function has been added. During automobile R&D and technology R&D, you can click the right button or Esc key to return to the upper-level interface.
4. Added a protection mechanism to prevent the massive sell-off of equity in the capital market.
5. Adjusted the rules of drawing research and development, now the unlocking speed of drawing technology tree is greatly accelerated.
6. Reduced the research and development costs of some drawings
7. Adjusted the time of automobile research and development.
8. Fixed the bug that occasionally got stuck in time.
PS: For cars that are already on sale before the update, the expected increase in sales is 0 after the iteration is completed. This is not a bug, because the data of the previous car is not available, and the effect of the iteration has actually taken effect. After the update is completed, the expected increase in sales of newly built cars will be displayed normally.
